translations.EN: Can you clarify what you mean?
translations.TL: Pwede mo bang linawin ang ibig mong sabihin?

translations.EN: What specifically are you talking about?
translations.TL: Tungkol saan ba partikular ang sinasabi mo?

translations.EN: I'm not following. Explain what you mean.
translations.TL: Hindi kita masundan. Ipaliwanag mo ang ibig mong sabihin.

translations.EN: Give me some more context on that.
translations.TL: Bigyan mo ako ng karagdagang konteksto tungkol diyan.

translations.EN: What do you mean by that exactly?
translations.TL: Ano nga ba ang ibig mong sabihin doon?

translations.EN: Which situation are you talking about?
translations.TL: Aling sitwasyon ba ang tinutukoy mo?

translations.EN: Could you break that down for me?
translations.TL: Pwede mo bang himayin 'yan para sa akin?

translations.EN: I need more details before I understand.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng dagdag na detalye bago ko maintindihan.
Saan ba patungo ang sinasabi mo?
